issues.caption: Four loose cable stubs, 10 to 13 cm long, stand off the left wall at 1.35 to 2.1 m and end on bare wall.
The vent sits on a solid wall: no opening behind it, nothing for the slats to vent.
Stair door at the top of the exit stair: no frame and nothing behind it.
The end wall reads empty: the reference shows a meter box and two signs there.
Top plan, cut at 1.6 m: rooms 1 and 2 grow about 1.5 times.
